newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 6.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Remoted controlled bomb found at home of major suspect of kidnapping and murdering teenage daughter of popular actress
-- New attorney-general convenes meeting to discuss security problem
UNITED DAILY NEWS - T$10 million reward offered to information leading to arrest of each of the three suspects kidnapping and murdering teenage daughter of popular actress
-- Five French Mirage 2000-5 jet fighters arrive in eastern Taiwan
LIBERTY TIMES - 20-minute blackout may cost science park T$5 billion in lost production
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Straits Exchange Foundation chairman Koo Chen-fu, former Mainland Affairs Council head Vincent Siew invited to attend Hong Kong handover ceremony
-- Cathay Life group actively engages in land development projects following property market rebound
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Power outage cost Hsinchu Science-based Industrial Park T$3 billion; semi-conductor firms worst hit
-- Lawmakers ask Securities and Exchange Commission to abolish system of requiring listed companies to report to the commission the forecast of their future financial conditions
